item.title: Mathematicians Buckmaster and Alpöge Claim Proof of Unforced Navier-Stokes Blowup
item.description: Tristan Buckmaster and Levent Alpöge claimed a proof of finite-time blowup for the unforced 3D Navier-Stokes equations. It addresses the challenge of fluid dynamics without external forces, a key issue in mathematical physics. — Upstream (r/singularity): https://www.reddit.com/r/singularity/comments/1y174f6/while_everyone_is_talking_about_riemann_tristan/

item.title: RL Post-Training in Diffusion Transformers Is Activation Steering
item.description: Researchers found that a small set of fixed steering vectors, added to a diffusion model, could achieve most of the gains from full reinforcement learning tuning. The challenge of creating highly complex, input-dependent transformations was simplified, making the models more practical for real-world applications. — Upstream (arXiv): https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26627v1
